claims.value: Nineteen pooled Norway-spruce thylakoid gel-band/spot acquisitions mapped by seasonal condition and gel feature from their deposited names.
claims.evidence: The paper defines summer, winter non-quenched, and sustained-NPQ samples; each deposited RAW name identifies its band/spot and all 19 are covered exactly once.

claims.value: Q Exactive HF for summer/sustained-NPQ HCD runs, Q Exactive for winter HCD runs, and Orbitrap Fusion Lumos for the named EThcD run.
claims.evidence: Instrument model strings were read from an 8 MiB metadata range of every RAW; mzML activation metadata and the paper distinguish HCD from EThcD.

claims.value: Trypsin, 10 ppm/0.02 Da, fixed Carbamidomethyl, and variable Oxidation, Phospho STY, and Protein N-terminal Acetyl.
claims.evidence: The deposited PD/Mascot MSF confirms the search settings.

limitations: Each row represents a gel feature from a pooled five-tree thylakoid sample, not an independent tree-level biological replicate.
Seasonal states are represented as matched growth-condition characteristic/factor values; gel-band/spot identity remains in source and assay names rather than being modeled as an experimental factor.
The reconciler treats the file-specific multi-instrument design as a contradiction; direct RAW metadata resolves the per-file assignments.
